title: Gears of War: E-Day
subtitle: Campaign 100% checklist
disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made checklist. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Microsoft, Xbox Game Studios or The Coalition. Gears of War is a trademark of Microsoft.
news: Hard Case totals added: 125 in all, with a goal for each act.

categories.name: Campaign
categories.note: A Prologue, five Acts (26 chapters) and an Epilogue.

items.name: Finish Boot Camp
items.detail: The tutorial opener. It has its own achievement.

items.name: Act 1
items.detail: Four chapters.

items.name: Act 2
items.detail: Five chapters. Where the bigger, semi-open areas begin.

items.name: Act 3
items.detail: Six chapters.

items.name: Act 4
items.detail: Six chapters, the longest act.

items.name: Act 5
items.detail: Five chapters. The finale.

items.name: Beat the campaign on Insane
items.detail: For the hardest difficulty achievement.

categories.name: Collectibles
categories.note: 140 collectibles in all (COG Tags included), tracked in the War Journal by act and chapter: 13, 38, 36, 41 and 12. Some can be missed, so explore before moving on.

items.name: Act 1 collectibles
items.detail: All 13.

items.name: Act 2 collectibles
items.detail: All 38. Some only appear during certain objectives, so grab them as you go.

items.name: Act 3 collectibles
items.detail: All 36. One Act 3 letter is picked up at the very start of Act 4.

items.name: Act 4 collectibles
items.detail: All 41, the most of any act. Check every pickup before the first train stop moves on.

items.name: Act 5 collectibles
items.detail: All 12. The last few are handed to you by story events.

items.name: All 140 collectibles
items.detail: Unlocks the collectibles achievement. Any difficulty counts.

categories.name: Hard Cases & side goals
categories.note: Side content in the bigger, more open chapters. Hard Case totals per early guides: 125 (Act 2: 36, Act 3: 38, Act 4: 46, Act 5: 5).

items.name: All 125 Hard Cases
items.detail: Unlocks the Hard Case achievement (any difficulty, no combat needed). Each case holds a mod or mod slot; fit them at a Supply Cache. None in Act 1.

items.name: Act 2: all 36 Hard Cases
items.detail: Per early guides (one chapter-by-chapter guide counts 35).

items.name: Act 4: all 46 Hard Cases
items.detail: The act with the most.

items.name: Every Secondary Objective
items.detail: Clear every campaign side objective. Any difficulty counts.

items.name: Every Supply Cache
items.detail: Unlock every Supply Cache item in the campaign.

categories.name: Combat feats
categories.note: Enemy and weapon feats. Campaign or Horde both count.

items.name: Turn a Ticker against its owners
Hit two Grubs with one Gut-Puncher shot
Get even with an Armored Wretch that stunned you
Save a teammate stuck wrestling a Locust
items.detail: Needs a second player.

categories.name: Horde Siege
categories.note: The co-op wave mode holds about a third of the achievements. Grind goals add up across matches.

items.name: Survive 50 Horde missions
items.detail: Infantry difficulty or higher.

items.name: Clear 25 Invasion Events
items.detail: Any difficulty.

items.name: Extract on Allfather with the whole squad alive
items.detail: The top difficulty. Bring a steady team.

items.name: Revive 250 downed squadmates with the Stim Vaporizer
Save your whole squad while you are close to death
Execute 50 enemies stunned by the Sonic Disruptor
Kill 10 enemies in a row with one detached turret
Keep Adrenaline going for 30 seconds with the Injector
Tag 1,000 enemies with the Pulse Drone
Get the top reward from a Perk Cache
Spend 150,000 Energy at the Supply Cache
Take a close look under a Raven
items.detail: A secret one. Look around the dropship.

items.name: Kill 50,000 enemies
items.detail: Any difficulty. The longest grind.

items.name: Reach player level 100 and Re-Up
items.detail: Re-Up is the prestige reset.

items.name: Max out Assault, Breacher, Marksman and Medic
Let a planted Demolition bomb go off
Win a Conquest match without the other team scoring
Cause a workplace accident on the Battleship map
items.detail: A secret one. Look for an environmental hazard.

categories.name: Big goals
categories.note: 55 achievements worth 1,000 Gamerscore (per guides). None reported missable.

items.name: Finish the campaign on any difficulty
Insane run with every side mission and hidden item
items.detail: The big campaign capstone.

items.name: The full grind capstone
items.detail: 100% campaign on Insane, 25,000 Versus kills, max player level and all four classes maxed.

items.name: 1,000 Gamerscore
items.detail: Every achievement, including Horde and Versus.
